content: MCP spec 2025-11-25 changelog (primary): tool naming guidance (SEP-986); servers MUST return HTTP 403 for invalid Origin on Streamable HTTP (PR#1439); experimental tasks (SEP-1686); icons metadata; URL-mode elicitation + enum schema improvements; sampling gains tools/toolChoice; input validation errors should be Tool Execution Errors not Protocol Errors (SEP-1303, enables model self-correction); JSON Schema 2020-12 default dialect; Implementation.description aligns with registry server.json; SDK tiering system; OIDC discovery + incremental scope consent.
